function: Excluded (function): IFFT-C2VNN estimates AoA, AoD, ToA of radar targets from channel estimates at a passive radar (p. 1, p. 6); sensing-only, no beam, waveform or resource design.
notes: Reason function. The PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint 'High-Resolution Sensing in Communication-Centric ISAC: Deep Learning and Parametric Methods', whose first line says 'accepted in IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications, 2025' (p. 1); it prints no DOI. A learned component exists (complex-valued CNN trained with MSE, p. 6 to p. 7), so no_learning does not apply. Its task is sensing: p. 1 'super-resolution sensing parameter estimation in bistatic configurations'; p. 6 'IFFT-C2VNN leverages complex-valued convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to directly predict the sensing parameters from the estimated CSI'; p. 7 the loss is the MSE of the predicted AoA, AoD and ToA of M targets. The CSI comes from a classical LS estimator, p. 4 eq. (8), at a passive radar unit; p. 4 'the communication function operates unchanged, without being disrupted or sacrificed, and the passive radar opportunistically performs sensing by reusing the BS downlink waveform'. The aim is localization-type target parameter estimation: p. 1 'sub-meter localization targets', p. 9 range 'inferred from the estimated AoD/AoA/ToA using standard hybrid localization methods'. This is direction-of-arrival and target parameter estimation alone; the paper designs no beams, waveforms or resources for sensing and communication (area 5) and estimates no communication channel for detection, feedback or precoding (area 2). The second method, PARAMING, is a parametric non-learned method (p. 7 to p. 9).
